name: NGC 3522 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3522, a slowly rotating early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3522-hubble
story: A slowly turning galaxy, one of a dozen that Hubble examined to learn how such galaxies are assembled. Its light keeps climbing toward the center instead of flattening into a core.

claims.text: NGC 3522 was one of 12 galaxies observed by Hubble program 13324 on the assembly of early-type galaxies
The 12 galaxies newly imaged by HST for this study are slow rotators (slowly rotating early-type galaxies)
NGC 3522 has a core-less light profile
